Build the platform that connects ad accounts, stores, CRMs and inboxes into one automated growth system for D2C brands.

3+ years experienceMumbai · Hybrid or Remote

What you will do

  • Design and build features across the web app, APIs and background jobs.
  • Integrate Meta, Google, Shopify, WooCommerce and WhatsApp APIs.
  • Own services end to end: build, test, ship, monitor.
  • Work with product and design to turn ideas into simple, fast interfaces.
  • Keep the codebase secure, tested and easy to change.

What you bring

  • 3+ years building production web apps with React or Next.js and Node.js or Python.
  • Strong SQL and API design skills (REST, webhooks, queues).
  • Experience with cloud hosting, CI/CD and monitoring.
  • Clear written communication and a habit of finishing what you start.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ad-tech, e-commerce or marketing platforms.
  • Experience with LLM or automation workflows.
  • Early-stage or SaaS product experience.

Run and shape the playbooks that ARINE automates. You will manage paid growth for D2C brands and help turn what works into product.

3+ years experienceMumbai · Remote India

What you will do

  • Plan, launch and optimise Meta and Google campaigns for D2C and e-commerce brands.
  • Own CAC, ROAS and contribution margin targets across accounts.
  • Run creative testing and report on what wins and why.
  • Build dashboards, weekly reviews and clear client updates.
  • Work with the product team to turn winning playbooks into automations.

What you bring

  • 3+ years managing Meta and Google Ads for D2C or e-commerce brands.
  • Proven results with budgets of ₹5 lakh+ a month or equivalent.
  • Strong in GA4, Shopify analytics and unit economics.
  • Clear communicator who can explain results to founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRO, email or WhatsApp marketing.
  • Experience with international markets (UAE, UK, USA, Singapore).
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools.
